Class Map

java.lang.Object
pt.ipp.isep.dei.domain.Map
public class Map extends Object
Represents the simulation map containing stations, industries, rail lines, cities, and locomotives on a 2D grid.

Provides methods to add and retrieve elements, validate coordinates, update state, and collect events during simulation steps.
